text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I stopped by a convenience store to 
pick up some items— for some reason, the 
shop was packed with people.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah! The line's not moving at 
aaaaaall!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I-It really isn't~. Who'd have thought 
this many people came for "that".

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It's a limited-time sweet that went on 
sale today. It's a chocolate nerikiri 
wagashi shaped like a cute little snow 
bunny~.
choice_data_list: You sure know a lot about it.
You really know a lot about it, huh?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. To tell ya the truth, it's from a 
sweet shop back home. I never dreamt I'd 
ever get to eat it here...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It's the taste of cherished memories! Even 
after leaving home, getting to eat that—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Uwooooh!! Yuki-chan, this is so exciting, 
isn't ittt!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Today's limited-edition sweets have 
completely sold out~! Please wait for the 
next shipment~!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: WHAAAAAT?! No waaaaay~~~~?!?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... And here I thought I'd finally 
get to eat it after so long.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Still, that just shows how much everyone 
loves it, don't it? It's a shame, but... I 
reckon I should be glad.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Mmmmmmmph............!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It's too early to give up!! I bet another 
store still has some in stock!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's go!! We are definitely 
buying that taste of your memories, 
Yuki-chan, no matter whaaaaaat!!!!
choice_data_list: Good luck! Hope you find it!
Do your best! I hope you can get one!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Waaaah!! They're sold out here tooooo!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Ticket-san, really, it's alright now. 
Just knowin' you care this much 'for my 
sake' is more than enough to fill me up.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
This is already our fifth shop, and 
draggin' ya around any more would be... 
Besides, I can just eat it next time I 
visit home!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Uuuu~!! But, buuuut——

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ah! That's it! Wait right there, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
So... what was all that about back there? 
Looked like you bought something, but—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, you'll see soon enough!! I'm gonna 
go borrow the kitchen for a bit~!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Take a round little cake and slap on some 
red gummies, bam, BAM!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
And for the finishing touch~, poke in some 
chocolate sticks, STAB!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ta-daaaa!! It's my custom snow bunny 
treat!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It's different from the one in your 
memories, but... Even so! It's packed with 
a whole bunch of delicious sweets!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ticket-san...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I stopped by to take a break, I 
spotted Winning Ticket and the others.
choice_data_list:
Looks like you managed to get sweets after 
all.

You were able to get some sweets after 
all, huh?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
No, well... in the end we couldn't buy 
'em. Even so, it's been a truly wonderful 
day!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
'Cause I got to make another wonderful 
memory♪

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Y-Yuki-chaaaan...!! Me tooooooo!!!!!
